extracted.name: Pistachio Cake with Frosting
extracted.description: This simple pistachio cake with frosting uses pistachio pudding mix and lemon-lime flavored carbonated beverage to deliver a recipe that is great for potlucks or family gatherings.
ingredient_lines: 2 (3 ounce) packages instant pistachio pudding mix
instruction_lines: Beat cake mix, oil, soda, eggs, and first package of pudding until smooth. Pour batter into a greased 9x13-inch pan.
Bake at 325 degrees F (165 degrees C) for 45 minutes, or cake tests done.
Beat Dream Whip, milk, and pudding until stiff; pour over cooled cake. Refrigerate.
